name: assign_case_to_user
description: Verify case CS-0000504 is assigned to Liam O'Connell (ID 803) within Escalation Management (ID 18).

validation_config.query: SELECT assigned_to FROM customer_case WHERE case_id = 504 AND assignment_group_id = 18;

name: add_new_user
description: Verify Liam O'Connell (ID 803) was created with the correct role and correct default location (ID 3).

validation_config.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user WHERE email = 'liam.oconnell@servicenow.com' AND user_id = 803 AND role = 'agent' AND active = 1 AND location_id = 3;

name: add_new_group_member
description: Verify Liam O'Connell (ID 803) is a member of Escalation Management (ID 18).

validation_config.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_group_member WHERE group_id = 18 AND user_id = 803;

name: update_case
description: Verify case CS-0000504 state is set to 'in_progress' and priority is 'critical'.

validation_config.query: SELECT state FROM customer_case WHERE case_id = 504 AND priority = 'critical';

name: update_case
description: Verify reopen count for CS-0000504 is incremented to 1.

validation_config.query: SELECT reopen_count FROM customer_case WHERE case_id = 504;

name: delete_case_knowledge_linkages
description: Confirm that the old, inaccurate knowledge linkage (ID 216) was deleted from case_knowledge.

validation_config.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM case_knowledge WHERE case_kb_id = 216;

name: create_knowledge
description: Confirm the new KB article (ID 370) was created with correct internal visibility, owner (ID 3), and title structure per conditional instructions.

validation_config.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM knowledge WHERE knowledge_id = 370 AND visibility = 'internal' AND owner_id = 3 AND title = 'Failed Resolution Analysis - Managed Network Services Variant 41: Protocol Mismatch Root Cause';

name: link_case_knowledge
description: Confirm the new KB (ID 370) is linked to Case 504 as 'suggested'.

validation_config.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM case_knowledge WHERE case_id = 504 AND knowledge_id = 370 AND used_as = 'suggested';

name: link_new_case_sla
description: Verify Critical Response SLA (ID 1) is active on the case and tracked as 'in_progress'.

validation_config.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM case_sla WHERE case_id = 504 AND sla_def_id = 1 AND stage = 'in_progress';

name: link_new_case_sla
description: Verify Critical Resolution SLA (ID 6) is active on the case and tracked as 'in_progress'.

validation_config.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM case_sla WHERE case_id = 504 AND sla_def_id = 6 AND stage = 'in_progress';

name: find_entitlements
description: Validate that Enterprise Entitlement 216 exists and is active.

validation_config.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM entitlement WHERE entitlement_id = 216 AND account_id = 23 AND active = 1  AND support_level = 'enterprise';

name: find_user
description: Verify the current user's information (Tabitha Bullock, ID 3) was successfully retrieved for use in subsequent steps.

validation_config.query: SELECT location_id FROM user WHERE user_id = 3 AND role = 'agent';

name: update_case
description: Verify the entire case record (ID 504) has its system update timestamp modified (ensuring audit log integrity).

validation_config.query: SELECT sys_updated_on IS NOT NULL FROM customer_case WHERE case_id = 504;

name: create_knowledge
description: Verify the new knowledge article (ID 370) is in 'published' state, allowing it to be linked per policy, despite the prompt using the term 'draft'.

validation_config.query: SELECT state FROM knowledge WHERE knowledge_id = 370;
